scope: Incremental Slash normal-baseline experiment; estimate, not bill or budget cap; no resources created by this review.

plan.ingress: Regional REST API -> VPC link V2 -> internal ALB

range_assumptions.time: All resources conservatively charged from creation until deletion is confirmed complete. 2/4h is total lifecycle time, not just test duration.
range_assumptions.CloudWatch_metric_hours: elapsed hours + 1, allowing for partial clock-hour boundaries
range_assumptions.private_DNS: Deleted within 12h: hosted-zone test exemption; private-zone queries free.
range_assumptions.discounts_credits_free_tier_and_tax: Not applied; actual charges can be lower with account allowances.

billing_rules.fargate_linux: Per second from image download to task termination, minimum 60 seconds; default 20 GiB ephemeral disk included.
billing_rules.public_ipv4: Per second, minimum 60 seconds per address.
billing_rules.rds_compute: Per second, minimum 10 minutes after a billable status change; stopping does not stop storage charges.
billing_rules.valkey_node: Every partial node-hour billed as a full hour.
billing_rules.alb: Every partial ALB-hour billed as a full hour; LCU charged separately by usage.
billing_rules.private_hosted_zone: No charge if deleted within 12h of creation; otherwise $0.50 for the first 25 zones, not prorated.
billing_rules.secrets: Hourly prorated storage; API calls charged separately.
billing_rules.metrics: Charged for hours in which custom metric data is published; old metric history alone does not keep producing ingestion charges.

additional_or_retained_costs: Surplus RDS T4g CPU credits $0.075/vCPU-hour. For this 2-vCPU instance, a conservative extra bound before baseline/credit offsets is $0.15 per elapsed hour; not included in the normal-baseline totals.
Private hosted zone retained past 12h: $0.50/month, not prorated. Additional elapsed time and partial ALB/Valkey hours add charges.
Request/log/LCU/network volume above assumptions and duplicate/retried tasks can exceed this range. The range is not a spending cap.
Existing ECR storage $0.10/GB-month, Cognito MAU/SMS/M2M, and existing LambdaOps/alarms/state are outside this experiment-only total. No new image upload or messaging is assumed.
Manual snapshots/backups, extra KMS API calls, Logs Insights queries, tax and exchange conversion are not included.
cleanup_required: Delete both ECS services and residual tasks; confirm task public IPv4 addresses/ENIs released.
Delete internal ALB, API Gateway stage/API and VPC link.
Delete RDS including any retained/manual snapshots; stopping alone leaves storage charges. Plan has backups=0, delete automated backups=true, skip final snapshot=true.
Delete Valkey and any manual snapshots; snapshot retention=0.
Deregister Cloud Map task; delete services/private namespace/private hosted zone within 12h.
Delete experiment log group and cache/Grafana secrets; confirm RDS-managed secret lifecycle cleanup. Stop custom metric publication.
Remove experiment network/IAM dependencies. expires_at is only a tag and does not automatically delete resources.
Keep existing foundation ECR/Cognito and LambdaOps separate; no deletion of those is authorized by experiment cleanup.
source_method: AWS Price List Query API GetProducts, read-only, queried 2026-10-29, with pricing/billing documentation below. SKU retained for reproducibility.
